segments.zh: 各位英语学习者，大家好。

segments.en: And today we have an intermediate level lesson talking about appearances.
segments.zh: 今天我们有一个关于外表的中级课程。

segments.en: We are going to change or somebody wants to change their appearance and they're going to have surgery.
segments.zh: 我们将改变或有人想改变他们的外表，他们将接受手术。

segments.en: Well, before we get started, let's look at what kind of surgery they're having in today's vocabulary preview.
segments.zh: 好吧，在我们开始之前，让我们看看他们在今天的词汇预览中进行了什么样的手术。

segments.en: So today we're going to be talking about plastic surgery specifically.
segments.zh: 所以今天我们将专门讨论整形手术。

segments.en: Well, basically, plastic surgery is, you know, surgery for your appearance, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，基本上，整形手术是为了你的外表，对吧？

segments.en: It's not really for health reasons.
segments.zh: 这不是真的出于健康原因。

segments.en: And sometimes they add things to you.
segments.zh: 有时他们会给你添加一些东西。

segments.en: Sometimes they take things away, but they're not for your health.
segments.zh: 有时它们会带走一些东西，但它们不是为了你的健康。

segments.en: They're not for your heart or your lungs.
segments.zh: 它们不适合您的心脏或肺部。

segments.en: Yeah. and also called cosmetic surgery.
segments.zh: 是的。 也称为整容手术。

segments.en: And we'll be hearing that later.
But cosmetic means having to do with your appearance like cosmetics.
segments.zh: 但化妆品意味着与你的外表有关，就像化妆品一样。

segments.en: So we're going to be talking about this.
segments.zh: 所以我们要讨论这个问题。

segments.en: Let's listen to our dialogue for the first time and we'll be back.
segments.zh: 让我们第一次听我们的对话，我们会回来的。

segments.en: I look as if I were 30.
But I think it's time for some plastic surgery.
segments.zh: 但我认为是时候进行整形手术了。

segments.en: I'm tired of these wrinkles and sagging skin.
segments.zh: 我厌倦了这些皱纹和皮肤下垂。

segments.en: I don't see any wrinkles or sagging skin.
segments.zh: 我没有看到任何皱纹或皮肤下垂。

segments.en: Besides, I think that people who get Botox have facelifts or tummy tucks look weird.
segments.zh: 而且我觉得打肉毒素、做拉皮或腹部整形的人，看起来都怪怪的。

segments.en: I think I'm going to get liposuction and a nose job and some breast implants as well.
segments.zh: 随便吧，我打算去抽脂、整鼻子，再隆个胸。

segments.en: I think you need to get brain surgery.
segments.zh: 我想你需要做脑部手术。

segments.en: I honestly don't think you need cosmetic surgery.
segments.zh: 老实说，我不认为你需要整容手术。

segments.en: I thought you were my friend and would support me on this.
segments.zh: 我以为你是我的朋友，会在这方面支持我。

segments.en: I just want to feel better about myself and feel more attractive.
segments.zh: 我只是想对自己感觉更好，感觉更有吸引力。

segments.en: You don't need plastic surgery to do that.
segments.zh: 你不需要整形手术来做到这一点。

segments.en: You're fine the way you are and you have guys drooling all over you.
segments.zh: 你现在这样就挺好，已经让那些男生垂涎三尺了。

segments.en: I got my nose job, I was black and blue for a week.
segments.zh: 我做完鼻子整形后，整整一个星期都青一块紫一块的。

segments.en: So yeah, they think this girl really wants to get this surgery.
segments.zh: 所以，是的，他们认为这个女孩真的很想接受这个手术。

segments.en: But she doesn't seem to know why.
segments.zh: 但她似乎不知道为什么。

segments.en: She's just like, I'm in a bad mood.
And it's pretty painful from what I hear.
Expensive and painful and potentially dangerous.
segments.zh: 昂贵和痛苦，潜在的危险。

segments.en: But we can talk about that at the end.
segments.zh: 但我们可以在最后讨论这个问题。

segments.en: So why don't we start with the words that we saw that are all related to surgery in Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 那么，我们为什么不从我们看到的所有与语言外科手术相关的单词开始。

segments.en: Okay, well this first one might be the reason for surgery, not necessarily a kind of surgery.
segments.zh: 好吧，这第一个可能是手术的原因，不一定是一种手术。

segments.en: Okay, so if a person is vain, this is an adjective.
segments.zh: 好吧，如果一个人是徒劳的，这是一个形容词。

segments.en: That means that they are very, they care too much about their appearance, right?
segments.zh: 这意味着他们非常关心自己的外表，对吧？

segments.en: And they care so much that they only care about themselves.
segments.zh: 他们非常关心他们，以至于他们只关心自己。

segments.en: I love my face, my eyes.
So a person who is vain thinks very highly of themselves.
segments.zh: 所以一个虚荣的人对自己的评价很高。

segments.en: And well, this person I think wanted to get surgery as well because she said she had wrinkles.
segments.zh: 好吧，我认为这个人也想接受手术，因为她说她有皱纹。

segments.en: Okay, wrinkles are little lines on your face.
segments.zh: 好吧，皱纹是你脸上的小纹。

segments.en: So maybe on your forehead or next to your mouth.
segments.zh: 所以也许在你的额头或嘴边。

segments.en: And generally, when we get older, people get more and more of these.
segments.zh: 一般来说，当我们变老时，人们会得到越来越多的这些。

segments.en: And you have, even you have wrinkly skin when you're in the bathtub for too long and you look in your hands, they look like raisins.
segments.zh: 而且你有，即使你在浴缸里呆了太久，你的皮肤上也有皱纹的皮肤，它们看起来像葡萄干。

segments.en: Wrinkles are little lines in your skin.
And well, you have wrinkles as you said around your mouth and eyes.
segments.zh: 好吧，正如你在嘴巴和眼睛周围所说的那样，你有皱纹。

segments.en: And sometimes under your eyes, you also have some sagging skin.
segments.zh: 有时在你的眼睛下，你的皮肤也会下垂。

segments.en: Under your chin as well, yeah.
So sagging means coming down, means it's heavy.
segments.zh: 所以下垂意味着下降，意味着它很重。
如此下垂，有些东西下垂。

segments.en: But if you have sagging skin, that means your skin is no longer tight.
segments.zh: 但如果你的皮肤下垂，这意味着你的皮肤不再紧绷。

segments.en: It's kind of loose and it hangs.
And well, a new popular treatment that is not really surgery is this Botox.
segments.zh: 好吧，一种不是真正手术的新流行疗法是这种肉毒杆菌毒素。

segments.en: So Botox is something that women and some men do every couple of months I think and they have to get shots.
segments.zh: 所以我认为肉毒杆菌毒素是女性和一些男性每隔几个月都会做的事情，而且她们必须拍摄。

segments.en: And so you can get Botox in your face, your forehead or your eyes and it makes you look younger for a couple of months.
segments.zh: 这样你就可以在你的脸上、额头或眼睛里得到肉毒杆菌毒素，它让你看起来更年轻几个月。

segments.en: I've heard that they also put them in their lips to make them like fuller, right?
segments.zh: 我听说他们也把它们放在嘴唇上，让它们像更饱满，对吧？

segments.en: And sometimes you can say that someone's had too much Botox because they can no longer smile or they can't stop smiling.
segments.zh: 有时你可以说某人有太多的肉毒杆菌毒素，因为他们不能再微笑或无法停止微笑。

segments.en: And well, very related to this is also when people get a facelift.
segments.zh: 好吧，这与人们进行整容时非常相关。

segments.en: So basically it's that a doctor, a plastic surgeon will tighten the skin on your face so he'll pull your eyes and the skin next to your ears to make your face look younger.
segments.zh: 所以基本上是医生，整形外科医生会收紧你脸上的皮肤，这样他就会拉动你的眼睛和耳朵旁边的皮肤，让你的脸看起来更年轻。

segments.en: So it's to kind of take away those wrinkles, right?
segments.zh: 所以它是为了消除这些皱纹，对吧？

segments.en: So this dialogue has a lot of rich vocabulary related to surgery.
segments.zh: 所以这个对话有很多与手术相关的丰富词汇。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to our dialogue again and we'll be back with the second part of language takeaway to explain a little bit more.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不再听我们的对话，我们会带着语言外卖的第二部分回来解释更多。

segments.en: I look as if I were 30.
But I think it's time for some plastic surgery.
segments.zh: 但我认为是时候进行整形手术了。

segments.en: I'm tired of these wrinkles and sagging skin.
segments.zh: 我厌倦了这些皱纹和皮肤下垂。

segments.en: I don't see any wrinkles or sagging skin.
segments.zh: 我没有看到任何皱纹或皮肤下垂。

segments.en: Besides, I think that people who get Botox, have facelifts or tummy tucks look weird.
segments.zh: 此外，我认为获得肉毒杆菌毒素、整容或腹部除皱的人看起来很奇怪。

segments.en: I think I'm going to get liposuction and a nose job and some breast implants as well.
segments.zh: 随便吧，我打算去抽脂、整鼻子，再隆个胸。

segments.en: I think you need to get brain surgery.
segments.zh: 我想你需要做脑部手术。

segments.en: I honestly don't think you need cosmetic surgery.
segments.zh: 老实说，我不认为你需要整容手术。

segments.en: I thought you were my friend and would support me on this.
segments.zh: 我以为你是我的朋友，会在这方面支持我。

segments.en: I just want to feel better about myself and feel more attractive.
segments.zh: 我只是想对自己感觉更好，感觉更有吸引力。

segments.en: You don't need plastic surgery to do that.
segments.zh: 你不需要整形手术来做到这一点。

segments.en: You're fine the way you are and you have guys drooling all over you.
segments.zh: 你现在这样就挺好，已经让那些男生垂涎三尺了。

segments.en: When I got my nose job, I was black and blue for a week.
segments.zh: 当我得到我的鼻子工作时，我一周是黑色和蓝色的。

segments.en: So what other surgical procedure is in store for us?
segments.zh: 那么我们还有哪些其他外科手术程序为我们准备呢？

segments.en: So we've left the face and we're talking about the rest of the body.
segments.zh: 所以我们离开了脸，我们在谈论身体的其余部分。

segments.en: The first one is a tummy tuck.
Well, let's look at these two words by themselves because maybe tummy, people have heard before.
segments.zh: 好吧，让我们自己看看这两个词，因为也许是肚子，人们以前听说过。

segments.en: This is another way to say stomach.
segments.zh: 这是另一种表达胃的方式。

segments.en: My tummy hurts and doctors, they'll say stomach.
segments.zh: 我的肚子疼，医生，他们会说胃。

segments.en: But the name of this surgery is tummy tuck because tuck means to put in or to fold.
segments.zh: 但这个手术的名字是腹部除皱，因为褶皱的意思是放入或折叠。

segments.en: And so my mom used to say tuck in your shirt.
segments.zh: 所以我妈妈过去常说把你的衬衫塞进去。

segments.en: You know when your shirt comes out of your pants and that means you put it back in.
segments.zh: 你知道你的衬衫什么时候从你的裤子里出来，这意味着你把它放回去。

segments.en: Well a tuck means to fold your stomach under.
segments.zh: 一个褶皱意味着将你的胃折叠起来。

segments.en: It means to make your stomach look smaller and they put staples or I think they sew you up.
segments.zh: 这意味着让你的胃看起来更小，他们把主食或我认为它们缝合了你。
是的，他们把你缝起来了。

segments.en: Usually this is because somebody got a liposuction for example and that's our next word, liposuction.
segments.zh: 通常这是因为有人接受了吸脂，这是我们的下一个词，吸脂。

segments.en: Okay, lipo, that's kind of fat, right?
And suction means to pull like a vacuum.
segments.zh: 吸力意味着像真空一样拉动。

segments.en: So that's basically what they do.
segments.zh: 所以这基本上就是他们所做的。

segments.en: They open the person up and kind of use a sort of vacuum type device and suck all the fat out of the stomach or the balcony areas, you know, the love handles that are also called.
segments.zh: 他们打开人并使用一种真空式设备，将所有的脂肪从胃或阳台区域吸出，你知道，爱情把手也被称为。

segments.en: And this way, they remove all this excess fat.
segments.zh: 这样，他们就去除了所有这些多余的脂肪。

segments.en: And because they do this, sometimes the skin, since it's been stretched out because you were a little bit fat, they need to have a tummy tuck.
segments.zh: 因为他们这样做，有时是皮肤，因为它被拉伸了，因为你有点胖，他们需要有一个腹部除皱。

segments.en: That means to hide the extra skin.
segments.zh: 这意味着隐藏多余的皮肤。

segments.en: The extra skin to kind of hide it.
segments.zh: 多余的皮肤可以隐藏它。

segments.en: So these two words, these two procedures actually go hand in hand because maybe if you're very fat you get a liposuction but that doesn't solve your problem because now you have all this sagging skin off your stomach.
segments.zh: 所以这两个词，这两个程序实际上是齐头并进的，因为如果你很胖，你会吸脂，但这并不能解决你的问题，因为现在你的胃里的皮肤都松了。

segments.en: So you have to have a tummy tuck as well.
segments.zh: 所以你也必须有一个腹部除皱。

segments.en: So yeah, very, very dangerous procedure I've heard as well, right?
segments.zh: 所以，是的，我也听说过非常非常危险的程序，对吧？

segments.en: And they usually only do it with people who are very, very fat.
segments.zh: 他们通常只对非常非常胖的人这样做。

segments.en: Because if you do it on a skinny person, you could really hurt them.
segments.zh: 因为如果你对一个瘦的人这样做，你真的会伤害他们。

segments.en: Yeah, of course, fat is also necessary for our bodies.
segments.zh: 是的，当然，脂肪对我们的身体也是必要的。

segments.en: Alright, so now moving back up to the face again, a very common procedure, I think one of the most common ones is a nose job.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以现在又回到脸上，一个非常常见的程序，我认为最常见的程序之一是鼻子工作。

segments.en: And so nose job is very colloquial.
segments.zh: 所以鼻子工作非常通俗。

segments.en: You'll hear this on the TV.
segments.zh: 你会在电视上听到这个。

segments.en: Nose job means to fix someone's nose, to change the shape or appearance of their nose.
segments.zh: 鼻子工作是指修复某人的鼻子，改变鼻子的形状或外观。

segments.en: And so oftentimes people with really big noses want smaller noses.
segments.zh: 很多时候，鼻子很大的人想要更小的鼻子。

segments.en: And so the doctor will take some bone away and will put the skin back.
segments.zh: 所以医生会拿走一些骨头，把皮肤放回去。

segments.en: So this is called a nose job or formerly known as like a nose surgery, right?
segments.zh: 所以这被称为鼻子工作或以前称为鼻子手术，对吧？

segments.en: And actually I've heard it's very painful because they have to break your nose before they fix it.
segments.zh: 实际上，我听说这很痛苦，因为他们必须在修复之前打断你的鼻子。

segments.en: I can't believe people do this.
segments.zh: 我不敢相信人们会这样做。

segments.en: And well, one of the very common ones among women most likely is our breast implants.
segments.zh: 嗯，女性中最常见的一种是我们的乳房植入物。

segments.en: So breast implants, am I allowed to say boob job?
segments.zh: 所以乳房植入物，我可以说胸部工作吗？

segments.en: Well, the very common phrase for this is boob job.
segments.zh: 好吧，这很常见的短语是胸部工作。

segments.en: Boob is a very colloquial term for breasts.
segments.zh: 胸部是乳房的一个非常通俗的术语。

segments.en: And breast implants are, well, an implant is something that you put inside something.
segments.zh: 乳房植入物是，植入物是您放置在某物中的东西。

segments.en: And so a breast implant is a piece of silicone.
segments.zh: 所以乳房植入物是一块硅胶。

segments.en: So it's like plastic, but it's more like a liquid plastic.
segments.zh: 所以它就像塑料，但它更像是一种液体塑料。

segments.en: Just imagine like this big plastic bag with like gel, right?
segments.zh: 想象一下像这个带有凝胶的大塑料袋，对吧？

segments.en: And they put that inside a woman's chest to make her breasts bigger.
segments.zh: 他们把它放在女人的胸膛里，让她的乳房变大。

segments.en: And so these are very, very popular surgeries, breast implants.
segments.zh: 所以这些是非常非常流行的手术，乳房植入物。

segments.en: I guess many models and many types, different types of women get breast implants.
segments.zh: 我猜有很多型号和许多类型，不同类型的女性获得乳房植入物。

segments.en: And the verb there is to get.

segments.zh: 于是她做了乳房植入物。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to our dialogue for the last time and we'll be back to talk a little bit more.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不最后一次听我们的对话，我们会回来多说一点。

segments.en: I look as if I were 30.
But I think it's time for some plastic surgery.
segments.zh: 但我认为是时候进行整形手术了。

segments.en: I'm tired of these wrinkles and sagging skin.
segments.zh: 我厌倦了这些皱纹和皮肤下垂。

segments.en: I don't see any wrinkles or sagging skin.
segments.zh: 我没有看到任何皱纹或皮肤下垂。

segments.en: Besides, I think that people who get Botox, have facelifts or tummy tucks look weird.
segments.zh: 此外，我认为获得肉毒杆菌毒素、整容或腹部除皱的人看起来很奇怪。

segments.en: I think I'm going to get liposuction and a nose job and some breast implants as well.
segments.zh: 随便吧，我打算去抽脂、整鼻子，再隆个胸。

segments.en: I think you need to get brain surgery.
segments.zh: 我想你需要做脑部手术。

segments.en: I honestly don't think you need cosmetic surgery.
segments.zh: 老实说，我不认为你需要整容手术。

segments.en: I thought you were my friend and would support me on this.
segments.zh: 我以为你是我的朋友，会在这方面支持我。

segments.en: I just want to feel better about myself and feel more attractive.
segments.zh: 我只是想对自己感觉更好，感觉更有吸引力。

segments.en: You don't need plastic surgery to do that.
segments.zh: 你不需要整形手术来做到这一点。

segments.en: You're fine the way you are and you have guys drooling all over you.
segments.zh: 你现在这样就挺好，已经让那些男生垂涎三尺了。

segments.en: When I got my nose job, I was black and blue for a week.
segments.zh: 当我得到我的鼻子工作时，我一周是黑色和蓝色的。

segments.en: So, as you mentioned, all of these surgeries are very painful and very expensive, right?
segments.zh: 所以，正如你所提到的，所有这些手术都是非常痛苦和非常昂贵的，对吧？

segments.en: The plastic surgery industry is huge.
segments.zh: 整形外科行业是巨大的。

segments.en: I was just reading an article that said that re-dos are becoming very popular.
segments.zh: 我只是在读一篇文章说重做变得非常流行。

segments.en: There are doctors who perform re-dos.
They're fixing other surgeries because oftentimes people go in, they say, I want a nose job, they get a nose job, and then it's not the nose they wanted.
segments.zh: 他们正在修复其他手术，因为人们经常进去，他们说，我想要鼻子工作，他们得到鼻子工作，然后这不是他们想要的鼻子。

segments.en: They have doctors now who specialize in fixing former surgeries.
segments.zh: 他们现在有专门修复以前手术的医生。

segments.en: I've heard also a lot about the plastic surgery tourism industry where people get offered a package, for example, to go to countries like Argentina where they have good doctors and it's very inexpensive compared to the states to get plastic surgery.
segments.zh: 我也听说过很多关于整形外科旅游业的人，人们会得到一个包裹，例如，去阿根廷这样的国家，那里有好医生，与美国相比，进行整形手术非常便宜。

segments.en: It's also popular now in Asia, I believe they're traveling to Hong Kong to get plastic surgery done.
segments.zh: 它现在在亚洲也很受欢迎，我相信他们要去香港做整形手术。

segments.en: But it's one of those things that if you have the money and you really feel that you want to improve your appearance, then-
segments.zh: 但这是其中之一，如果你有钱，你真的觉得你想改善你的外表，那么——

segments.en: Yeah, it is a little bit fake.
Like, for example, but it does help people with their self-confidence, right?
segments.zh: 比如说，但它确实帮助人们自信，对吧？

segments.en: Sometimes, for example, with the case of breast implants, some women feel very, very self-conscious about them having smaller breasts.
